description: Weekly, grouped dependency PRs. Vercel only builds main; CI (ci.yml) checks each PR. Minor and patch updates to devDependencies merge themselves once every CI check passes; runtime dependencies, GitHub Actions, lockfile maintenance and majors wait for a human.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Non-major updates to runtime npm dependencies arrive as one weekly PR, merged by a human.
Non-major updates to devDependencies arrive as their own weekly PR and merge themselves once every CI check passes.
react-hook-form and redux-logger sit in devDependencies but ship in the app bundle, so they are runtime code: update them with the runtime group and merge by hand.
GitHub Actions updates arrive as one PR, merged by a human.
Majors wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard and never merge themselves.
@types/node follows the Node runtime major (Vercel runs Node 24). Bump it deliberately.
